items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who were the partners, Steve? [INTERVIEWEE] One of them's obvious, Larry McKinley.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. No question about it. And the original Minute Records had a couple of partners who were partners by virtue of their ability to get records played, as opposed to participating either in the capitalization or the operation of the company.
One of them's obvious, Larry McKinley.
